name: crewboard
description: Crewboard — Your crew, your board, your flow.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix functions install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix rules-tests install
scripts.emulators: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-crewboard --import=.emulator-data --export-on-exit=.emulator-data
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-crewboard "npm --prefix rules-tests test"
